newsitem.title: UK: LME encourages trade to study SIB metals review.
newsitem.headline: LME encourages trade to study SIB metals review.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) is asking members to ensure that a Securities and Investments Board (SIB) consultative document is seen by as many people as is appropriate.
In a notice to members, Exchange CEO David King said a significant number of industry participants have yet to receive a copy of the document, dated August 1996.
The document forms an integral part of the review the SIB is carrying out into the LME and its markets, which the Exchange sought after Sumitomo Corp's losses, announced in June.
"The LME supports the objectives of the document, which describes in significant detail the workings of the LME and asks a number of questions," King said.
"The LME is therefore keen to ensure that the document is received by the appropriate persons in appropriate companies and that they are encouraged to respond to the questions asked."
Members are being asked to check with their clients that the document has been distributed, and if this has not happened to contact the SIB.
